scoring_justification: Primary verification is sign and relative ordering of couplings, with numeric tolerances applied where paper-reported values are available. J2 Ge scored by sign and ordering because the paper does not give an explicit numeric gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold J^s values and ordering rules
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct transcription from paper text and derived ordering from reported magnitudes
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the published reference values that a correct reproduction must match

outputs.description: Computed J^s values for the specified Cu–Cu pairs. All numbers signed (negative = AF, positive = FM); units Å⁻¹.

output_contract.notes: The verifier compares the submitted J^s values to a hidden reference within a tolerance and checks that the sign and relative magnitude ordering are correct.
